# Axis coastal ships

Used in [Ports and shipping](/rules/logistics/50-ports-and-shipping).

## Table

| Id | Counter | Capacity tons |
|---|---|---|
| ship:axis:a | A | 1000 |
| ship:axis:b | B | 1000 |
| ship:axis:c | C | 1000 |
| ship:axis:d | D | 2000 |

## Notes

- 56.31 prints each coastal ship's cargo capacity on its counter, not in the rules or charts. The archive.org scan has no counter sheet; the four counters and their tonnages are read from the VASSAL module (CNAv2.1.0, errata applied), the only source we hold for them, so the figures await a check against a printed counter sheet (decision board, copy group).
- Every ship has CPA 50 for movement only, uses no fuel and carries one kind of cargo at a time (56.31-56.35, rules/logistics/50-ports-and-shipping.md). The cruiser San Giorgio shares the module's coastal-shipping prototype but is a blocking ship at Tobruk (R-082), not a cargo ship.
